title: Flora A NDE 4681
content: I fell and hit my head. I moved through a tunnel with concentric rings. The tunnel became two tunnels and my sister was moving with me in the second tunnel, a little behind me, until she fell back and her tunnel disappeared. I moved on. Flashes of colored light appeared as I moved through the tunnel. There was wonderful music. I moved toward a light, which was dull at first and then became larger and brighter. Some individuals in brown robes with hoods met me. I am not aware of knowing them. We had a lot of conversation that I have never been able to remember. I saw my grandmother standing off to the side and there was some conversation, which again I cannot recall (at this time my grandmother was in the hospital, still alive). I could see past the hooded figures to a meadow. I wanted to keep going and enter the meadow but the figures would not allow it. I then became aware and felt like I had gravel in my mouth. My dog was barking loudly in my ears, running from one ear to the other, and was licking my face all over. I spit out the ‘gravel’, which was broken teeth. My dog ran to the doors barking and tried to open them, even clawing down the curtains on the glass sliding doors. After a while, I realized that I was on the floor and that a glass topped table was lying beside me, broken. I was then aware of the pain and the fact that I had passed out and fallen on the hard terrazzo tiles. I called for help. My grandmother died a short time after my fall. I don't now remember how many days later. For about three months after the accident, I was not all here, but was not aware of it until an experience with a robed individual like the ones I had seen at the end of the tunnel. I was walking down a street in San Francisco and had an urge to walk into a large church. The church was empty and dark and then the figure just appeared up at the front of the church, at the podium. Again, there was some kind of conversation that I have never been able to recall. When I walked outside the world was different. Everything was louder and faster, and the colors were all more subdued. I realized that up to that point I just wasn't all the way here. My entire life changed. Nothing has ever been the same again. The path I was moving along just changed into another path.

arrival.other_being_detail: Individuals in brown robes with hoods met her; she was not aware of knowing them.

environment.environment_other_detail: Could see past the hooded figures to a meadow.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell and hit head; passed out and fell on hard terrazzo tiles; broken teeth; glass-topped table broken beside her.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Tunnel split into two tunnels; sister was moving in the second tunnel until she fell back and her tunnel disappeared; later (months after) a robed figure appeared in an empty dark church and she again had a conversation she could not recall; afterwards the world was louder/faster and colors more subdued.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two-tunnel split with sister present briefly; later post-accident encounter with a similar robed figure in a church.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Encounter/communication with a robed figure occurred again months later in a church.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel became two tunnels; sister present in a second tunnel and then her tunnel disappeared. Grandmother seen standing off to the side while she was still alive in the hospital. Later, a robed figure appeared in an empty dark church months after the accident, followed by altered perception and realization she "wasn't all the way here" for about three months.

Nothing has ever been the same again.”
